title: Phone call with Rep. Mike Gallagher and interview with House subcommittee staff

tellings.quote: after one phone call with uh representative Mike Gallagher Republican representative W of the of his district in Wyoming

plain: In 2024, Eric W. Davis says, one phone call with Mike Gallagher, a Republican member of Congress, was enough to get him an interview with the staff of a House subcommittee. Davis tells Michels this about himself, in an episode where he says a US president was briefed on UFOs. It would mean Congress was willing to hear quickly from someone with his story.
